blocks.title: Company profile
texts: CHUNG YIP HOLDING PTE. LTD. is a diversified investment management company headquartered in Singapore, committed to discovering high-potential assets, cutting-edge technology projects and long-term growth opportunities in the Asia-Pacific region. Guided by the core philosophy of “global vision, local execution,” we leverage Singapore's strategic position as an international financial centre and innovation hub to build a resilient, innovation-driven and future-oriented investment portfolio that creates sustainable long-term value for investors.

We adhere to a long-term investment philosophy, strategically focusing on high-growth areas such as industrial real estate, new building materials, education, AI-driven healthcare, digital infrastructure and intelligent software ecosystems, continuously building cross-industry, vertically integrated investment capabilities and resource integration expertise. At the same time, we place great importance on ESG-oriented sustainable development opportunities, promoting the deep integration of capital, technology and industry. With two decades of experience in the Asia-Pacific market, our professional team is committed to becoming a strategic bridge connecting capital, industry and innovative technology.

columns.heading: AI + education
columns.text: CHUNG YIP leverages its majority-owned Singapore Heng Xing International School to actively explore the deep integration of artificial intelligence technology and the education industry.

columns.heading: AI + medical
columns.text: CHUNG YIP cooperates with BUZUD, a well-known home-grown Singaporean healthcare brand, to jointly explore innovative applications and solutions for artificial intelligence technology in the healthcare field.

blocks.title: Openness, cooperation and mutual benefit
